LA. Care Health Plan administers health insurance programs for children and adults residing in Los Angeles County. The
organization offers various health coverage programs such as Medi-Cal, Healthy Kids, Medicare Advantage HMO SNP, Covered
California (L.A. Care Covered), Cal MediConnect, and PASC-SEIU, each with its own eligibility and income guidelines. For specific
eligibility information, individuals are encouraged to contact the plan directly, as each program has different requirements and
guidelines. Additionally, medical advice and consultation can be obtained through the Nurse Advice Line. Medi-Cal caters to low-
income adults and children, with members having the option to receive care from L A Care, Anthem Blue Cross, Care Ist Health
Plan, or Kaiser Permanente. Program benefits cover dental care, doctor visits, hospital and emergency room care, immunizations,
mental health services, prescriptions, substance abuse services, and vision care. Healthy Kids is designed for children aged zero
to five, offering services like doctor visits, dental care, immunizations, mental health services, vision care (including glasses),
hospital and emergency room care, and prescriptions. Meanwhile, Medi-Care Advantage plans cater to individuals entitled to
Medicare Part A, enrolled in Medicare Part B, without End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD), and having full Medi-Cal benefits without a
share of cost.
